waypoints.name: Cutthroat Peak Climbers Trail Pullout (Hwy 20, ~1.5 mi W of Washington Pass, north side)
waypoints.note: Same pullout as South Buttress; from the basin south of the peak, ascend to the headwall and twin gullies to the notch at the base of the Southeast Buttress
waypoints.directions: Drive the North Cascades Highway (SR-20) to the long pullout on the north side of the road about 1.5 miles west of Washington Pass, roughly half a mile west of the Blue Lake Trailhead. The climbers' track leaves the east end of the pullout. SR-20 over Washington Pass is closed in winter, typically from late fall until spring.

waypoints.name: Cutthroat Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the cairned track from the east end of the pullout down through timber, cross State Creek, and climb the open slopes on the east side of the southeast-draining stream into the basin south of the peak. At the headwall, start up the right-hand of the twin gullies and traverse into the left-hand one to reach the notch at the base of the buttress, then climb near the buttress crest to the summit.
